status_codes.name: Continue
status_codes.description: The server has received the request headers, and the client should proceed to send the request body.

status_codes.name: Switching Protocols
status_codes.description: The requester has asked the server to switch protocols.

status_codes.name: Processing
status_codes.description: The server has received and is processing the request, but no response is available yet.

status_codes.name: Early Hints
status_codes.description: Used to return some response headers before final HTTP message.

status_codes.name: OK
status_codes.description: The request was successful.

status_codes.name: Created
status_codes.description: The request was successful and a new resource was created.

status_codes.name: Accepted
status_codes.description: The request has been accepted for processing, but processing is not complete.

status_codes.name: Non-Authoritative Information
status_codes.description: The response is successful but contains modified information from a third-party.

status_codes.name: No Content
status_codes.description: The request was successful but there is no content to send in the response body.

status_codes.name: Reset Content
status_codes.description: The request was successful and asks the client to reset the document view.

status_codes.name: Partial Content
status_codes.description: The server is delivering only part of the resource due to a range request from the client.

status_codes.name: Multi-Status
status_codes.description: Provides status information for multiple independent operations.

status_codes.name: Already Reported
status_codes.description: The members of a DAV binding have already been enumerated.

status_codes.name: IM Used
status_codes.description: The server has completed the request and the response is a representation of the result of instance manipulations.

status_codes.name: Multiple Choices
status_codes.description: The request has multiple possible responses for the client to choose from.

status_codes.name: Moved Permanently
status_codes.description: The requested resource has been permanently moved to a new URL.

status_codes.name: Found
status_codes.description: The requested resource has been temporarily moved to a different URL.

status_codes.name: See Other
status_codes.description: The response can be found under a different URI and should be retrieved using GET.

status_codes.name: Not Modified
status_codes.description: The resource has not been modified since the version requested by the client.

status_codes.name: Use Proxy
status_codes.description: The requested resource must be accessed through the specified proxy.

status_codes.name: Temporary Redirect
status_codes.description: The requested resource has been temporarily moved to a different URL.

status_codes.name: Permanent Redirect
status_codes.description: The requested resource has been permanently moved to the new URL.

status_codes.name: Bad Request
status_codes.description: The server cannot process the request due to a client error, such as malformed syntax or invalid parameters.

status_codes.name: Unauthorized
status_codes.description: The request requires valid authentication credentials.

status_codes.name: Payment Required
status_codes.description: Reserved for future use, sometimes used to indicate a paid subscription is required.

status_codes.name: Forbidden
status_codes.description: The server understood the request but refuses to authorize it.

status_codes.name: Not Found
status_codes.description: The server cannot find the requested resource.

status_codes.name: Method Not Allowed
status_codes.description: The request method is not supported for the requested resource.

status_codes.name: Not Acceptable
status_codes.description: The server cannot produce a response matching the content characteristics requested.

status_codes.name: Proxy Authentication Required
status_codes.description: The client must authenticate with the proxy before proceeding.

status_codes.name: Request Timeout
status_codes.description: The server timed out waiting for the request to be sent.

status_codes.name: Conflict
status_codes.description: The request could not be completed because of a conflict with the current state of the resource.

status_codes.name: Gone
status_codes.description: The requested resource is no longer available and will not be available again.

status_codes.name: Length Required
status_codes.description: The server requires the Content-Length header to be present in the request.

status_codes.name: Precondition Failed
status_codes.description: One or more preconditions given in the request evaluated to false on the server.

status_codes.name: Payload Too Large
status_codes.description: The request payload is larger than the server is willing or able to process.

status_codes.name: URI Too Long
status_codes.description: The URI requested by the client is longer than the server is willing to interpret.

status_codes.name: Unsupported Media Type
status_codes.description: The media type of the request is not supported by the server.

status_codes.name: Range Not Satisfiable
status_codes.description: The client has requested a range that cannot be satisfied by the server.

status_codes.name: Expectation Failed
status_codes.description: The expectation indicated in the Expect request header cannot be met by the server.

status_codes.name: I'm a teapot
status_codes.description: I'm a teapot (April Fools' RFC 2324, no actual usage).

status_codes.name: Unprocessable Entity
status_codes.description: The request was well-formed but cannot be processed due to semantic errors.

status_codes.name: Too Many Requests
status_codes.description: The client has sent too many requests in a given amount of time.

status_codes.name: Request Header Fields Too Large
status_codes.description: The request header fields are too large for the server to process.

status_codes.name: Unavailable For Legal Reasons
status_codes.description: The server is unable to serve the requested resource due to legal demands.

status_codes.name: Internal Server Error
status_codes.description: The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.

status_codes.name: Not Implemented
status_codes.description: The server does not support the functionality required to fulfill the request.

status_codes.name: Bad Gateway
status_codes.description: The server, while acting as a gateway, received an invalid response from the upstream server.

status_codes.name: Service Unavailable
status_codes.description: The server is currently unable to handle the request due to temporary overload or maintenance.

status_codes.name: Gateway Timeout
status_codes.description: The server, while acting as a gateway, did not receive a timely response from the upstream server.

status_codes.name: HTTP Version Not Supported
status_codes.description: The server does not support the HTTP protocol version used in the request.
